description:
Transform your ideas into social media posts and organised project boards.

With this app you can turn the ideas and media you generated through ChatGPT into social media drafts or even scheduled posts in the SocialHub Content Planner. Additionally, you can get channel suggestions for the content based on your connected platforms in SocialHub.

If you use the Idea Board, you can also use this app to draft cards or build complete boards with structured columns and cards based on your current discussion/prompt.
